input.summary: keel_payments_20260923.csv has amounts apparently in cents rather than dollars (sum 39,499,206.00 vs trailer control total 394,992.06; unannounced unit change breaching contract v2.1). Please correct and re-send as keel_payments_20260923_r1.csv. Cc vendor-management@harborlending.example. Partition quarantined on our side.

The 2026-09-23 Keel payments file has amounts about 100x too large, which looks like cents instead of dollars. The loaded total was 39,499,206.00 against a trailer control total of 394,992.06. That caused the negative-balance test failure, the dbt_build failure and the stale mart_delinquency. I quarantined the partition, and the rebuild and publish succeeded. I escalated to Keel to re-send a corrected _r1 file. Once it arrives, the 2026-09-23 partition will need reprocessing.
